notation: magazine-v2: L1 masthead (cover); L2 section (running section tag or section banner, when the section changes); L3 article headline; L4 in-article subhead. An article whose section is not printed sits directly under the masthead (L2). Cover lines, ads, colophon/masthead boxes, TOC entries, run-in 【...】 brief labels are text.
